confirmation.revertedWhy: Linea has one sequencer and no fork choice between competing blocks; 30 blocks (about 6 minutes) is far beyond a restart of it, and the page's endpoints do not agree on a safe or finalized tag. Not the chain's finality.

measured.safeLagSeconds: 6072 on the first endpoint, 0 on the second
measured.finalizedLagSeconds: 6072 on the first endpoint, 0 on the second (review R309-MC-2: 5 h 6 min on the first)
measured.blockSpacing: blocks are made when there is work: 3 to 82 s apart over 40 blocks, 11.5 s on average over 1,000

confirmation.residualRisk: The two reviewed endpoints disagree on what `finalized` is (the first answers the block proven on Ethereum, hours behind; the second answers the head), so the tag is used for neither rule. settle: one block on top (about 11 s on average, up to minutes when the chain is quiet, because Linea makes a block only when there is work); a sequencer reorganisation deeper than 1 block shows an outcome the chain replaced. strict: 300 blocks (about an hour at the measured average) is NOT the chain's finality: a sequencer reorganisation deeper than that could let a swap execute after the page ended its hold.

notes: Multicall3 at the canonical address has another runtime code hash than on the other five chains (another build); its interface is checked by call
